description: Lightweight Python package for reading fixed-width text files from the CLI or Python code.
rules: Open files in binary mode when using fixwidth.DictReader.
A layout file begins with a title, then tab-delimited width, datatype, and field-name entries.
Negative widths skip bytes in the source record and do not appear in parsed rows.
Blank field content becomes None before type conversion.
Use type_errors='ignore' to continue parsing and replace invalid fields with None.
parse_file() defaults to ASCII decoding while parse_lines() defaults to UTF-8 decoding.
